description: NaNbZnP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.75 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.08 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.61 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-37°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one P atom.
